Package main.java.progOO2.p20

package main.java.progOO2.p20

Programming Object Oriented II: Library

This package introduces working with collections of objects, where books are created based on user input and stored in a list. The exercise allows the user to choose what information should be displayed about the books.

Classes:

  • Book represents a book with a title, number of pages, and publication year. It provides getter methods for encapsulated fields and a toString() method for a formatted description.
  • Library contains the main method. It prompts the user for book information (title, pages, year), stores the data in an ArrayList, and finally asks the user what information should be printed ("everything" or just the title).

Key learning goals:

  • Collections: Storing and managing objects inside an ArrayList.
  • User input: Reading structured input to create objects dynamically.
  • Conditional output: Allowing the user to decide which attributes of the objects should be displayed.
  • Encapsulation: Keeping fields private and exposing them only through getters.
  • String representation: Using toString() to return a human-readable description of the object.

This exercise helps students practice designing simple data classes, working with collections, and adapting program output based on user decisions.
